record.question: A parasite is best defined as:
options: An organism that lives freely in the environment
An organism that lives in or on another organism and harms the host
An organism that benefits the host
A free-living organism with no host dependence
record.explanation: Answer B: An organism that lives in or on another organism and harms the host. A parasite lives in or on a host and obtains benefit at the host’s expense; not every parasitic relationship causes obvious harm, but this is the best offered conventional definition. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/about/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
